items.text: The remote control design will be a multi-functional gadget capable of controlling household devices such as TV, air conditioners, and heating systems.
The remote control should be original, trendy, and user-friendly with a focus on design elements such as shape, color, and materials.
Eileen and S3 will try out the whiteboard and demonstrate how to use it for presentations in the next meeting.
S3 will attempt to draw a cat or rabbit to demonstrate how the remote control's front scene might look.
S2 will draw a snake as part of the remote control design concept.
The remote control should include a light or beep signal when it is hidden (e.g., behind a plant or under a sweater) to help users locate it.
The remote control should have a sensor that detects darkness and triggers a signal (light or beep) when it is in a dark spot.
The selling price of the remote control will be 25 euros, with a target profit of 50 million euros and an international market range.
The production cost should not exceed 12.50 euros to ensure profitability.
The design process will include three stages: functional design, conceptual design, and detailed design, each involving individual work followed by group discussion.
S4 (industrial designer) will be responsible for the technical functional design and specifications of the remote control.
S3 (marketing person) will develop user requirement specifications, including friendliness, functionality, and price justification.
